test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 12th Sep 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Why has the gap between education and wisdom become wider in recent times?

options.text: Because of rote learning and algorithm-dependent systems

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The passage states that modern education focuses heavily on **memorization and standardized testing**.
 
• Such rote-learning-based systems limit critical thinking, reflection, and moral reasoning, all of which are essential for wisdom.
 
• Due to this mechanized, exam-driven approach, the gap between **education (information)** and **wisdom (application + ethics)** has widened.
 
• Hence, the most appropriate option is the one referring to rote learning and mechanical systems.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Option 1:** Social media is not mentioned in the passage.
 
• **Option 2:** The passage does not say wisdom is undervalued; it explains why it develops differently.
 
• **Option 4:** The passage clarifies that education ends with degrees, but wisdom continues lifelong. This does not explain the widening gap.
